briefing.headline: Anthropic's Claude 4 edges out rivals in multi-agent benchmarks amid surging investments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute buildout hits new highs. Funding surges past $9B this quarter with safety concerns mounting across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: Anthropic ships Claude 4 with advanced reasoning. xAI's Grok-3 enters wide beta while DeepSeek releases R2 competitor.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU proposes new AI audit rules.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ramps Blackwell production to 2M units monthly. Google and Microsoft announce joint Texas data center expansions totaling 500MW.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge before 2028 according to leading labs?
